answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each agent to a sequentially delayed seed, so a cloned identity inherits no verifiable history; the basalt-hard entropy of that seed, fixed before any pigment of behavioral proof accrues, renders spoofing information-theoretically infeasible under min-entropy bounds. Verifiable delay primitives thus force a raven-like scarcity of forgery: divergence among Sybil copies is measurable, collapsing adversarial advantage below negligible thresholds.
